messages:
alex.w: Quick sync — big customer asked to launch the realtime dashboard this week. Product wants go/no-go. Question: do we gate on achieving the 99th pct write latency SLO or can we ship with mitigations?

maya: Can you share current SLO burn and recent incidents? need raw numbers to weigh impact vs effort.

chris: Last 30d p99 writes = 320ms (SLO 250ms) during load spikes; 3 incidents tied to queue pressure in that window. Overall error rate low.

tara: Those spikes are due to prefix cache evictions + a hot routing rule. Fix is medium effort (2–3 days), but mitigations possible: rate-limit non-critical writes, add a short backoff client-side.

olivia.pd: From product: customer is high value, impact = high. They want launch to unblock sales. If we delay, churn risk. Can we do a controlled rollout and call it an "early access"?

alex.w: Thinking tradeoff: RICE-wise impact high, confidence medium. Effort to hard-fix SLO is non-trivial and would block other Q3 bets. Propose compromise: 10% canary + automatic rollback if p99 > 400ms for 10m. Also add synthetic checks and an ops runbook.

maya: Canary sounds fine. How quickly can we implement rollback + synthetic probes?

tara: I can wire up the synthetic checks and the runbook today (1 day). Canary rollout policy + autoscale guardrail is another day. So 48 hours total to safe-launch path.

chris: Need to capture the acceptance criteria in the rollout PR. Suggested rule: 
```
canary: 10%
alert: p99_write_latency > 400ms for 10m
action: rollback to previous route + scale-down
```
Also add a toast metric for client error ration.

olivia.pd: Product ok with 48h to set safety net, will tell customer launch targeted after guards. They prefer not to delay further.

alex.w: Decision: ship to 10% with canary + synthetic checks + runbook. No full GA until SLO back to target or we have proven stability for 2 weeks.

sre-bot: deploy scheduled by @tara at 1905580000 — canary policy attached.

chris: I'll own PR for monitoring + alerting.

tara: I'll implement probes + runbook and do the deploy.

maya: I'll update the roadmap RICE notes to mark this as "customer-led quickship" and log the residual SLO debt (effort estimated 2–3 days).

olivia.pd: Logging the expectation to customer: early access + safety net, full GA after stability window. Thanks team :thumbsup:

alex.w: Nice. Capture follow-ups: (1) PR with canary + alerts (owner: chris) (2) probes + runbook + deploy (owner: tara) (3) roadmap note + customer comms (owner: maya/olivia). We'll re-evaluate SLO fix priority in next planning session.

chris: adding checklist to PR now.

tara: will post deploy playbook in #eng-oncall when done.

olivia.pd: :party-parrot:
